query:
INSERT INTO news (slug, title, excerpt, coverImageUrl, blocks, categoryId, date, publishedAt, createdAt)
VALUES (
  'utah-shakespeare-festival-2022-season',
  'Assistant Scenic Designer: Utah Shakespeare Festival 2022 Season',
  'Supporting Jo Winiarski''s scenic designs for Trouble in Mind, Clue: On Stage, and The Sound of Music during an on-site summer season in Cedar City, Utah.',
  'https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/FGkCvwFedaUxZBGx.jpg',
  '[{"type":"text","content":"The 2022 season at Utah Shakespeare Festival marked my second summer working on-site in Cedar City, providing drafting and technical support for scenic designer Jo Winiarski across three distinct productions: the meta-theatrical drama *Trouble in Mind*, the comedic murder mystery *Clue: On Stage*, and Rodgers and Hammerstein''s beloved musical *The Sound of Music*."},{"type":"header","content":"The Productions"},{"type":"text","content":"**Trouble in Mind** presented Alice Childress''s powerful 1955 play about a Black actress confronting racism in the theatre industry. The production featured a detailed backstage setting that served the play''s meta-theatrical commentary on representation and authenticity in American theatre.\\n\\n**Clue: On Stage** brought the classic board game to life with an opulent mansion setting complete with multiple rooms, secret passages, and comedic murder mystery mayhem. The scenic design supported the fast-paced physical comedy and multiple endings that made this production a Festival favorite.\\n\\n**The Sound of Music** required Jo Winiarski to evoke the Austrian Alps and the von Trapp family villa, creating iconic locations from one of musical theatre''s most beloved stories. The production ran in the Randall L. Jones Theatre throughout the summer season."},{"type":"image","url":"https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/dVAxEMYtQzOTfMrs.jpg","caption":"The Sound of Music at Utah Shakespeare Festival, 2022. Scenic design by Jo Winiarski. Photo courtesy Utah Shakespeare Festival."},{"type":"image","url":"https://files.manuscdn.com/user_upload_by_module/session_file/310519663337866878/GFmzHetgcTrLczbP.jpg","caption":"Trouble in Mind at Utah Shakespeare Festival, 2022. Scenic design by Jo Winiarski. Photo courtesy Utah Shakespeare Festival."},{"type":"header","content":"On-Site Technical Process"},{"type":"text","content":"Being on-site for the 2022 season provided hands-on experience with the Festival''s rotating repertory system, where three productions share the same theatre space. This required careful coordination during technical rehearsals and changeovers, ensuring each scenic design could be efficiently loaded in and struck while maintaining the integrity of Jo Winiarski''s vision for each production."},{"type":"header","content":"About Utah Shakespeare Festival"},{"type":"text","content":"The Utah Shakespeare Festival in Cedar City is one of the nation''s premier regional theatre companies, recipient of the Tony Award for Outstanding Regional Theatre. The Festival produces eight plays each summer in rotating repertory across three theatres, combining Shakespeare''s works with classic and contemporary plays and musicals."},{"type":"link","url":"https://www.bard.org","label":"Visit Utah Shakespeare Festival"}]',
  90002,
  '2022-09-10',
  '2022-09-10',
  NOW()
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  title = VALUES(title),
  excerpt = VALUES(excerpt),
  coverImageUrl = VALUES(coverImageUrl),
  blocks = VALUES(blocks),
  categoryId = VALUES(categoryId),
  date = VALUES(date),
  publishedAt = VALUES(publishedAt);
